mapper.select: SELECT I.INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId, I.TITLE AS title, I.CONTENT AS content, I.INQUIRY_STATUS AS inquiryStatus, DATE_FORMAT(I.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(I.UPDATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt, I.USER_ID AS userId, R.REPLY_ID AS replyId, R.CONTENT AS answer, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS replyCreatedAt FROM INQUIRY I LEFT JOIN INQUIRY_REPLY R ON I.INQUIRY_ID = R.INQUIRY_ID WHERE I.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY I.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT ${pageSize} OFFSET ${offset}

SELECT INQUIRY_IMG_ID AS inquiryImgId, IMG_URL AS imgUrl, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, INQUIRY_ID AS inquiryId FROM INQUIRY_IMG WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INQUIRY ( user_id, title, content, inquiry_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{inquiryStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
